{{Quote|Thank you for restoring peace between my father and Uncle Jonas. And to their space station. I am really happy about that."<br />"I'm glad I could help."<br />"You're my new best friend. Farewell.|The ghost of Katiara Orion and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KP" />}}
'''Katiara Orion''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she revealed herself as a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] to a heroic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who salvaged the rivalry between her father [[Garrick Orion]], and his longtime friend of [[Jonas Nova]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Jonas Nova was in his office with some less than reputable men who were apparently threatening him. Instead of coming to the security team ,as he should have, Jonas took matters into his own hands. Unfortunately, Katiara chose that moment to walk into his office. She was caught in the crossfire as Jonas tried to defend himself. He accidentally shot Katiara!|Skyron Waurie, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] by the name of Katiara Orion was the daughter of [[Garrick Orion]], an occupant of [[Nova Orion Station]] who served as one of the founders of [[Nova Orion Industries]], along with his old friend [[Jonas Nova]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Katiara [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="SWG:TR" /> Following her death, a mutual feeling of distrust and suspicion festered between the two founders of Nova Orion Industries, soon sparking the [[Nova Orion Crisis]]. However, it turned out that a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] by the name of [[Ter-Doac Vaine]] was responsible for polluting the minds of these two businessmen, with the hope of seizing control of Nova Orion Station for himself. A heroic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] foiled this plot and killed the diabolical Dark Jedi, thus restoring peace between Katiara's father and his longtime friend.<ref name="SWG:EG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|End Game|the Nova Orion Station}}</ref> Garrick then asked of the spacer to deliver a [[Tombstone|gravestone]] to the final resting place of Katiara Orion, located on the upper floor of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] near her favorite [[Flower/Legends|flowers]]. After doing so, Katiara revealed herself to the spacer as a glowing blue [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]], thanking the individual for helping to reconcile the relationship between her father and his friend. She then bestowed to the spacer her favorite toy of a stuffed [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The spacer returned this toy to Katiara's father, providing a source of comfort for his grief.<ref name="SWG:KP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KatiaraOrionNoGhost.jpg|180px|thumb|Emulated depiction of Katiara Orion, albeit without the glowing Force ghost effect]]
Katiara Orion appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Katiara Orion was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Nova Orion Main Quest Guide|"Nova Orion" quest series]] introduced in the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]],<ref name="SWG:KP" /> released on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="C8">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
